title.narrative: Nigeria Health project

description.narrative: Girls and Boys have improved access to quality child eye health services in Kaduna, Sokoto and Zamfara states, Nigeria, resulting in reduced prevalence of childhood blindness and visual impairment.

Usmanu Danfodiyo University Teaching Hospital Sokoto
